"""Camera-signal denoise (B) at each state of the strength-law reference, same masks and common area.
Usage: python campaign_b.py EXE REFERENCE.json OUT.json"""
import json, sys, time
from pathlib import Path
import numpy as np
sys.path.insert(0, str(Path(__file__).parent))
from strength_law import BASE, RenderServer, masks, metrics, read8  # noqa: E402


def main():
    exe, ref, out = Path(sys.argv[1]), json.loads(Path(sys.argv[2]).read_text(encoding="utf-8")), Path(sys.argv[3])
    report = json.loads(out.read_text()) if out.exists() else {}
    with RenderServer(exe, timeout=900) as server:
        for scene, s in ref["scenes"].items():
            if scene in report:
                continue
            t0 = time.time()
            ca = s["masks"]["common_area"]
            (lx, ly), (ix, iy), (w, h) = ca["lr_origin_xy"], ca["ipr_origin_xy"], ca["size_wh"]
            m = masks(read8(BASE / "neutre" / f"{scene}.tif")[ly:ly + h, lx:lx + w])
            pixels = {k: int(v.sum()) for k, v in m.items()}
            assert pixels == s["masks"]["pixels"], scene
            raw = next(p for p in BASE.iterdir() if p.stem == scene and p.suffix.upper() in (".CR3", ".CR2"))
            entry = {}
            for key in s["measures"]["B"]:
                lum, col, sharp = map(int, key.split("/"))
                sh = {"sharpening": {"amount": sharp, "radius": 1.0, "masking": 0}} if sharp else {}
                im = server.render(raw, "neutral", 0, camera_denoise={"luminance": lum, "chrominance": col}, **sh)[0]
                entry[key] = metrics(im[iy:iy + h, ix:ix + w].astype(np.float32) / 257.0, m)
            report[scene] = entry
            out.write_text(json.dumps(report, indent=1))
            print(scene, f"{time.time() - t0:.0f}s", flush=True)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
